svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Slingshot — planning mode (nebula level: asteroid band, ringed giant)
svg.desc: Planning-mode mockup of a nebula level: an emission nebula behind the left half, an asteroid band crossing the lower middle, the yellow sun in the centre, a Saturn-like ringed planet as the slingshot body, an icy moon, the ocean-world start and planet X; ship on the start world with the drag arrow at 62 % power, dotted predicted path threading a gap in the asteroid band and swinging around the ringed planet's far side toward planet X, HUD with fuel, Launch and telemetry.
